title: Enhancing pan-cancer spatial transcriptomics at single-cell resolution with stPainter.
snippet: Subcellular spatial transcriptomics can resolve tissue architecture at cellular scale, but sparse gene panels and limited detection sensitivity constrain downstream analysis. title: Immune niche composed of C1Qmacrophages/SFRP2CAFs/CD8T cells drives immunotherapy response in HER2-positive gastric cancer.
snippet: Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) expression is a distinctive feature of a subgroup of gastric cancer (GC) but the underpinning characteristics of the immune microenvironment and mechanisms remain unclear.
